name: Arcturus Recon Hawk
description: A high-speed reconnaissance drone capable of crossing the entire city in minutes. Unlike the surveillance-focused Shadow or patrol-focused Sentinel, the Recon Hawk is built for speed — a dart-shaped airframe with folding wings that can be launched from a handheld tube and recovered by net or cable catch. They carry optical and signal-intelligence packages and transmit in real-time. During security operations, Hawks are the first thing in the air and the last thing you want to see overhead.
propulsion: Electric ducted fan, tube-launched with booster
common_usage: Rapid reconnaissance, target tracking, search operations, aerial mapping during incidents.
story_hooks: A Recon Hawk's footage reveals something in the no-fly zone above the old power plant that shouldn't be there — and someone deletes the footage within minutes
Stolen Recon Hawks are being used by freelancers to scout jobs, giving them an intelligence advantage that corporate security can't explain
